gates_from_plan.adoption: Candidate/base native p50 above 1.05 on any cell rejects adoption pending resolution; all failed or flagged children remain in the packet.
gates_from_plan.allocator_review: Any paired retained-live, region-peak, or whole-child max-RSS increase above 5% is a retained review flag. Allocator elapsed is informational; requested bytes alone cannot support an adoption claim.
gates_from_plan.correctness: Every child must exit zero, report the frozen source hash and expected route/binary identity, and pass marker/output verification where applicable.
gates_from_plan.native_review: Any paired candidate/baseline p50, p95, p99, spread, or whole-child RSS increase above 5% is a retained review flag; no selective recapture.
